approval: Chapters 1–3 are provisionally approved as the technical and design baseline, on automated evidence only. Real-device validation is outstanding. Not approved for public release.

tests.name: Record the device and software
tests.automatedEvidence: Device facts: nothing to automate.

tests.name: Conditions
tests.automatedEvidence: Test conditions on the phone.

tests.name: Access and tools
tests.automatedEvidence: The published preview bundle loads with no failed requests, in live, lab and static modes (smoke test). Signing in and the phone's Chrome: not tested.

tests.name: Accuracy run, default tier
tests.automatedEvidence: Tier B (the A26 default) at an A26-sized screen (384×832 @2.8125). Spec run: 8 probed frames, point P99 0.005 px / max 0.011 px, edge max 0.018 px. Dense run: 74 frames, point P99 0.005 px / max 0.24 px, edge P99 0.024 px / max 2.23 px (limit 3 px; thinnest margin seen). GPU: SwiftShader, not the A26's Mali GPU.

tests.name: Accuracy run, tier A forced
tests.automatedEvidence: Tier A, spec and dense runs, desktop and mobile: worst point max 0.15 px, edge max 0.03 px; repeated in the e2e suite on every run. SwiftShader.

tests.name: Visual check of the guide points
tests.automatedEvidence: CPU/GPU point agreement is measured (T1.1). The edge's visual position was reviewed on headless frame sheets and close-ups; the overlay itself not viewed on the phone.

tests.name: Accuracy after warm-up (optional)
tests.automatedEvidence: Needs a warm phone.

tests.name: Slow pass, top to end card
tests.automatedEvidence: Automated: M1 handoff test (perceptual Δ 1.44 on mobile, limit 2); Chapter 2 lines reveal in order; the Chapter 3 page opens and covers; render pause at full cover. The look of the sequence was reviewed on headless frame sheets. Smoothness and appearance on the A26: not tested.

tests.name: Slow pass back up
tests.automatedEvidence: Automated: rendering resumes when scrolling back from full cover (I4 test). Reverse visuals: not tested.

tests.name: Fast flicks
tests.automatedEvidence: Fast flicks: no automated equivalent.

tests.name: Exact positions vs the frame sheet
tests.automatedEvidence: Reference frames exist for every position (mobile lab sheet, headless). Not compared on the phone.

tests.name: Load and handoff
tests.automatedEvidence: Handoff Δ passes in emulation (M1 test 1.44, readout 1.13; limit 2). Tier choice rule is unit-tested. Visual seamlessness and absence of downgrades on the A26: not tested.

tests.name: Scroll pass with measurements
tests.automatedEvidence: CLS passes (Lighthouse 0.001 mobile; scripted scroll 0). Frame-time criteria (Ch3 transition P95 ≤ 34 ms, median ≥ 45 fps) have NO valid automated evidence: SwiftShader frames saturate at 100 ms.

tests.name: Tier A headroom (optional)
tests.automatedEvidence: Tier A headroom on the A26: device only.

tests.name: Visual stability (watch while scrolling)
tests.automatedEvidence: No horizontal overflow at 41 scroll positions, live and reduced, at 384 px. CLS passes. Address-bar show/hide behaviour: not tested.

tests.name: I6 matched still (experiment)
tests.automatedEvidence: Simulated: matched still Δ 1.17 vs 1.13 for the standard still, so I6 stays not adopted. The decision needs the phone.

tests.name: Phone setting: Remove animations
tests.automatedEvidence: prefers-reduced-motion emulated (M1 test): static anchor, no canvas, all text visible; static spreads checked (stills, every line visible, page drawn, no 3D). The Samsung “Remove animations” → Chrome mapping itself: not tested.

tests.name: Preview flag (setting OFF)
tests.automatedEvidence: Static spreads e2e test with the reduced flag, desktop and mobile.

tests.name: Back to normal
tests.automatedEvidence: Every live e2e test runs with motion on, after reduced-motion tests in the same suite.

tests.name: Buttons and links
tests.automatedEvidence: Menu dialog opens, closes and returns focus (e2e); CTA targets (#enquire, #next) and the skip link are tested. Tapping on the phone and the landing position after a jump: not tested.

tests.name: Finger on the hair
tests.automatedEvidence: The M1 pointer test is skipped on touch by design.

tests.name: Enquiry form and keyboard
tests.automatedEvidence: The send button is disabled and nothing is ever sent (M1 test). On-screen keyboard behaviour: not tested.

tests.name: Layout at every chapter
tests.automatedEvidence: No horizontal overflow at 384 px; axe finds no WCAG 2.1 A/AA violations (static, reduced, live). Banner overlap reviewed on headless sheets only.

tests.name: Pinch zoom
tests.automatedEvidence: Pinch zoom: device only.

tests.name: Rotation
tests.automatedEvidence: Emulated rotation round-trip at Chapter 1 and the Chapter 3 rest: no errors, live 3D restored in both orientations. OPEN RISK: in emulation, rotating at the Chapter 3 rest moved the scroll position to the end card (380 vh → 865 vh in landscape → 679 vh back in portrait). Real Chrome may keep the place by scroll anchoring; only the phone can tell.

tests.name: Large text
tests.automatedEvidence: Large system font: device only.

tests.name: Samsung Internet (optional)
tests.automatedEvidence: Samsung Internet: not available here.

tests.name: Reading order, reduced motion
tests.automatedEvidence: Chromium's accessibility tree (what TalkBack reads), reduced motion: every heading and line present once, in this order; no decorative items; axe clean. TalkBack's speech itself: not heard.

tests.name: Reading order, normal motion
tests.automatedEvidence: Live-mode tree identical to reduced motion at 0, 160, 380 and 470 vh (e2e; the test fails on the build before the fix).

tests.name: Headings navigation
tests.automatedEvidence: Headings in order (h1, then four h2) in the tree, in both modes.

tests.name: Skip link
tests.automatedEvidence: The skip link moves focus to the h1 (e2e, keyboard). TalkBack double-tap: not tested.

tests.name: Menu dialog
tests.automatedEvidence: Focus moves into the dialog, Escape closes it, focus returns to Menu (e2e). Android back gesture and TalkBack swipe containment: not tested.

tests.name: Header focus after scrolling down
tests.automatedEvidence: TalkBack focus outline position: device only.

tests.name: Explore by touch (normal motion)
tests.automatedEvidence: Explore by touch: device only.

tests.name: Performance trace of the full scroll
tests.automatedEvidence: Needs a computer connected to the phone.

tests.name: Long-task attribution: start-up vs scrolling
tests.automatedEvidence: Needs a computer connected to the phone.

tests.name: Memory after a full scroll
tests.automatedEvidence: Needs a computer connected to the phone.

tests.automatedEvidence: Needs a computer connected to the phone.
